# Vanguard Standing Orders
How the [color=#a4885c]Vanguard[/color] is expected to act now that the war is over. Ignoring these may get you punished by your superiors.
[color=#d93c3c]OOC Note: These orders are In Character only and will not be punished by admins short of breaking the actual OOC rules. You may follow or disobey them of your own free will, but you may face IC punishments from your superiors.[/color]
## Always
1. The Lattice comes first. When an anchor or relay is under attack, every Vanguard ship in range answers alongside whoever else is answering.
2. The war is over until the Sultan says otherwise. Do not fire on the Federation, and do not give them a reason to fire on you.
3. If the Federation fires first or boards you, defend yourself and report it to the [color=#b8860b]Asvaran[/color] or the [color=#9b59d0]Grand Vizier[/color]. They will settle it with the Colonel. Do not settle it yourself.
4. Answer distress calls from anyone fighting Reavers, the ADS, the Chimera or the hives. Those are the enemy.
5. Leave civilians alone. They are the Sultan's subjects, whether or not they know it.
6. Hunt heretics. Anyone who answers the song or raises a hand against an anchor is branded a heretic.
7. Salvage, drop pods and Monolithic Fragments go to whoever reaches them first. Racing the Federation for them is fair. Shooting them over it is not.
## If the Accord breaks (WAR LEVEL: HOT)
Only the [color=#9b59d0]Grand Vizier[/color] and the Colonel together can break [textlink="the Caelestinus Accord" link="WGLoreAccord"], and every soldier knows what it may cost.
1. Federation ships and marines can be attacked anywhere, and the [italic]Halcyon[/italic] can be struck.
2. The Lattice still comes first. Never raise a hand against an anchor.
3. If the Accord is restored, stop fighting. Lick your wounds, and pray.
